Commentary.Commentary: As for the Oman bowlers, Aamir Kaleem was the pick for them as he snapped up a 3-fer conceding just 14 runs. Khawar Ali also bowled well as he took a 3-fer too. The bowling unit for Oman was in sync all along and there were no loose ends to target. Oman have to chase down a small target of 103 runs and it should be a comfortable one for them. Can Hong Kong spring an upset? Stay tuned to find out.

A quick interview with Aamir Kaleem. He starts by thanking the Almighty and says that this performance has made his birthday special. Feels the wicket is not easy to bat on as the ball was gripping. Tells that they planned to not give easy runs. On the target, he hopes to scale it down without losing too many wickets.

Oman elected to bowl after winning the toss for the second time in a row and they have executed their game plan perfectly right from the word go. They never let the Hong Kong players get going and runs were difficult to come by as the pitch was on the slower side. The ball was gripping and the Hong Kong players struggled to score runs as a result. Nizakat Khan was the only batsman who got going a bit but he too scored at a rate of less than run-a-ball. Only two batters other than him even reached double digits.

OUT! RUN OUT! So Hong Kong have been bowled out for 102! The last ball is a full one on middle. The batter swings but it goes off the inner half towards the leg side. They take one and go for the second which was not on. The fielder from mid-wicket picks the ball up and underarms it to the keeper who whips the bails off.
A short one on middle, it is ducked under.
Shorter and around off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Just short! Length and around off, the batter swings hard but is early in the shot. It goes off the bottom and lands short of the bowler.
100 up for Hong Kong. They still have 4 more balls to add to that. this is fuller and on off, it is driven towards cover for one.
On the stumps, this is kept out.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shahid Wasif departs and Hong Kong are 99 for 9 now! Fayyaz bowls another slower delivery on a good length outside off. Wasif tries to smash it down the ground but mistimes it. Aamir Kaleem runs in from long off and takes the catch. Fayyaz Butt finishes with figures of 3-016-12 and he has been top notch today. Hong Kong struggling to cross the 100-run mark.
Good slower ball by Fayyaz as Wasif looks to cut this one but misses.
Rana pushes this fullish one towards mid off for a single.

Lucky but good improvisation by Nasrulla Rana! Rana looks to paddle scoop this one towards the fine leg region, Fayyaz spots it and bowls it way wide outside off. Rana quickly adjusts and gets an inside edge on it as the ball goes towards fine leg and the batters take a couple.
Length ball outside off, Wasif cuts it towards point for a single.
Short ball wide outside off, Wasif looks to go for the upper cut over third man but misses.
Well fielded but could not stop the single! Fuller and around off, this is carved towards point where the fielder dives to his left and stops it.
A single now! Very full and on middle, this is hit towards mid off for a run.
Swing and a miss! The batter comes down the track and looks to go down the ground but misses the line completely.
A yorker just outside off, the batter plays down the wrong line and gets beaten.
This is angled into the pads, the batter looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Shorter and on middle, the batter is late in the pull shot and gets beaten.
Nasrulla Rana is the new man in. Change in bowling too as Bilal Khan comes back into the attack. 2-0-14-0 so far for him.

OUT! Chops it on! No. 8 is down. Kaleem ends his spell with a wicket. This is flatter and outside off, Khan hangs his bat out away from the body. The ball hits the inside edge and shatters the stumps behind. Can Oman bowl them out under 100?
One more dot as this is worked to the man at mid-wicket.
Looks to play the sweep shot by getting outside the line of off. He misses to get hit on the body.
Another tossed up ball, this is eased down to long on for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Slower through the air outside off, the batter looks to put bat on ball but misses.
Kaleem is back on! 3-0-12-2 so far for him.
Ehsan cuts this one past the point fielder and takes three runs.
Floated on middle and off, Khan pushes this one back towards the bowler.
Ehsan Khan is the new batsman, one of the most experienced players for Hong Kong.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Sharp catch by Khawar Ali once more! He serves this one on middle and off, gives it a bit of air. Barkat gets onto the back foot and looks to push it back past the bowler but does so uppishly. He does not time it well and Khawar Ali takes a sharp catch stretching to his right. Hong Kong lose their seventh wicket and they are collapsing dramatically.
The googly on off, this is eased down to long on for one.
Brings out the slog sweep but hits it nowhere in the middle. It goes towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Two! Shorter and outside off, this is cut behind point and the batters take two.
Shahid Wasif is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Suicidal stuff from Hong Kong here! There was never a run available but the pressure must be getting to the batsman now. Shortish ball outside off, Barkat cuts this one just wide of the man at point. Aqib Ilyas there collects it and throws it on the go to the keeper who whips the bails off in a flash. Simandeep is well short despite his dive and he has to depart. Getting to 120 looks like a big task from here now.
On middle and leg again, Singh pushes this towards long on and rotates the strike.
Now plays this one through mid on for one.
FOUR! Graceful shot this one! Floated ball just outside off, Barkat makes room and goes inside out over the cover region for a beautiful boundary.
Floated on middle and leg, pushed towards mid on for one.
Short one outside off, cut towards the man at point.
Shortish ball on the leg side, Simandeep rocks back and pushes this one towards long on for one.
On the pads of Simandeep, he works this with soft hands towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Outside off, shortish ball, Barkat cuts it towards the man at point.
Down the leg side, the batter flicks this one in the gap at square leg and takes a couple.
On off again, pushed towards long off for a single again.
Floated on off, pushed towards long off for one.
Outside off, cut towards point. Just 3 runs off the over.
On the pads of Singh, he flicks this one in the gap at mid-wicket. The batters want two and they get it easily as the throw from the deep is a poor one.
Simandeep Singh does well to get his bat down in time to this flatter delivery as he pushes it back to the bowler off the inside half of his bat.
On off, pushed towards cover.
Darted on middle and off, Barkat looks to push at this one but it goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Barkat cuts it towards the man at point.
Simandeep Singh is the new man in. He will have to play a fabulous knock to bring back Hong Kong into the contest.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Half the side back in the hut and the score is just 5 more than 60. McKechnie brings out the reverse sweep as he looks to be innovative. He though ends up hitting it straight to point where Aqib takes a sharp catch. The hole keeps getting deeper for Hong Kong.
Comes down the track and works it through mid-wicket, its in the gap and two is taken.
On off, this is guided towards point for one.
McKechnie comes down the track and works it through square leg for one.
Gives it a lot of flight and lands it on off, it is driven to covers.

Just short, misfield and three! Shorter and outside off, this is cut towards point. It lands just short of the fielder and it goes through. The fielder in the deep runs to his left and does the mopping up job. Three taken.
Similar one, McKechnie again leaves this one outside off. He thought that this was a wide too but nothing from the umpire.
Outside off, McKechnie thought this was outside off but it is inside the tramline.
Scott McKechnie is the new man in.

OUT! STUMPED ON THE SECOND ATTEMPT! Nizakat looks to come down the track but Kaleem does well to spot that. He bowls a flatter one way outside off and Nizakat misses it. The keeper collects it and tries to whip the bails off but misses in the first attempt. However, he has enough time to make amends and whip the bails off on the second attempt. A big blow for Hong Kong as the set batsman Nizakat departs. It has also been signaled a wide but Oman won't mind it.
Darted on middle and off, Barkat pushes it down the ground and takes a single.

Floated on the pads, Nizakat comes down the track and slaps it down the ground towards long on. The fielder there lets it through between his legs and misfields. However, he does well to recover as he dives behind and fields it inside the field. Three runs taken.
Outside off, slapped to the cover fielder.
Flatter one on off, pushed back towards the bowler.
One more short ball, Khan goes back and slaps it through covers for one.
Shorter and quicker outside off, Nizakat looks to cut but misses.
On off again, kept out.
Loopy ball on off, this is defended.
Floats it up on middle, this is dragged through square leg for one.
Waqas Barkat is the new man in for Hong Kong. Can he arrest the slump?

OUT! Caught and bowled! We saw Kaleem pick a wicket on the second ball of his first over and now Ali takes one on the first ball of his first over. A soft, soft dismissal. That was a nothing delivery from Ali. A loosener. Short and on middle, Arshad could have hit it anywhere. He though ends up playing the pull shot very early. It goes off the bottom edge and straight back towards the bowler who may not have been expecting it. The ball hits his shoulder and to his luck pops up. After that it becomes an easy catch. Two wickets in quick succession. Hong Kong in trouble.
Khawar Ali to bowl his leggies now.

A loud appeal but turned down. This is fired on the pads, the batsman looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. Going down leg one can say. End of a successful over by the spinner.
On off, kept out.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Out comes the paddle sweep. It is hit fine on the leg side for two.
Haroon Arshad, the 20-year old, is the new man in.

OUT! In the air... and straight to the man! The fielder in the deep did not have to move an inch. Kinchit thought he could take on the left-arm spinner with the ball turning into him. He brings out the slog sweep. The boundaries here are long so he really needed to hit it well. Does not do so and it goes straight to the man at deep mid-wicket where Jatinder Singh takes it and then does the Dhawan-like celebration. Poor shot selection to be honest, that ball was a little too full to play that shot. Joy for Oman as they have put a stop to a budding stand. Kaleem strikes on the second ball of his spell.
Gives it a lot of flight and lands it on off, it is driven down to long off for one.
Aamir Kaleem replaces Aqib Ilyas now.
An ambitious appeal from the player! This lands outside leg. The batter looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. A top over comes to an end. Just the two from it.
A low full toss outside off, Kinchit strokes it to covers. This is an excellent over till now but he needs to end it well.
Outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
One more dot! Shorter and outside off, this is guided to point.
Swing and a miss! This is outside off, the batter throws his bat at it but misses.
Nicely played in the end! Shorter and outside off, Kinchit looks to cut but it gets big on him. He does well to adjust and get it over point for one.

SIX! First maximum of the game! Nizakat Khan dances down the track and slams this floated delivery on middle and leg over the mid-wicket fence. That is the largest part of the ground and there is a man there but he times it superbly and clears the fence with ease.
On the pads of Nizakat, works it towards the man at mid-wicket.
Kinchit flicks this one towards fine leg and takes a single.
Good running by Kinchit Shah from the non-striker end. Ilyas bowls it down the leg side, Nizakat tucks it towards fine leg and Kinchit is off for a quick single.
On the pads again, blocked out.
On the pads of Nizakat, he flicks this one towards square leg for a couple.

A little too straight, the batter looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads. A muted appeal but the umpire shakes his head. End of the 6th, a good one. A quiet Powerplay for Hong Kong. They are 35 for 1.
Uppish but safe again! One more slower one on middle, Kinchit is slightly early in the stroke. He gets it over mid on for two.
Slightly shorter again and outside off, KS guides it to point.
Good length and on off, this is kept out.
Quick run! A slower one on middle, this is worked towards short fine leg for one.
On the stumps, this is pushed to the man at mid off.
Mohammad Nadeem is into the attack now.
FOUR! A poor ball to end the over! It is short and on middle, Kinchit goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket. Spoils what was a top over till then.
One more delivery angled into the batter, it is cut to cover-point.
Fired into the stumps, the batter pushes it to mid off.
On the shorter side outside off, it comes slow off the surface. The batter looks to cut but ends up chopping it towards covers.
Slightly shorter again, Nizakat pulls it through squrae leg for one.
Flatter and on middle, it comes in with the angle. Kinchit looks to cut but it is too close to play that shot. he gets an inside edge on the leg side and a single is taken.
Spin time! Aquib Ilyas is on now!
Short ball outside off, Nizakat opens the face of his bat and plays this one over the point fielder inside the circle for a couple.
Length ball outside off to Kinchit, he slashes at it but does not time it perfectly. The ball goes towards deep cover and the batters take three as the fielder mops it up in the deep.
Kinchit Shah is the new man in. He played a good knock in the last game and he needs to play one more here.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! The skipper for Hong Kong departs cheaply again. Fayyaz bowls a short ball outside off, it is slow in pace and stays a touch low after pitching. Aizaz looks to pull it powerfully towards the leg side but he manages to get just an inside edge on it and chops it onto the leg pole. A good start for Oman after electing to bowl first.
Good length ball outside off, pushed towards point.
Back of a length ball on the body, Aizaz rocks back and pulls this one towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Beaten! Length ball outside off, it nips away a bit. Aizaz looks to fend at it but is beaten.
Wide! Short ball above head height, Aizaz lets it through to the keeper. Wided by the umpire.
Good running again! This is fuller and around off, it is hit towards covers for one.

Up and over! Not a boundary but three! A slower one, it is fuller on off. Nizakat seems to be done in by the pace but goes ahead with the shot. He manages to clear mid off who hares after the ball and manages to push it back in. Saves a run for his side.
In the air... but safe! A short delivery on middle, it gets big on the batter. He tries to pull but gets a top edge which lands safe in the square leg region. A single taken.
One more length ball coming in from outside off, it is worked with the movement through square leg for one.
A slower one now on off, NK works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! First boundary of the game! Slapped through the off side. Width on  offer by Bilal and Nizakat takes full toll of it. He throws his hands at it and gets it through covers for a boundary.
A single to end the second. 4 from it as well. Nizakat makes room and the bowler bowls a slower one on middle, the batter ends up dragging it through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on off, the batter goes back and keeps it out.
An off pace delivery on middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
On a length again around off, the batter guides it to point.
Goes short again but this time on the body, it is pulled behind square on the leg side for one.
Good carry for the bowler there! Shorter and outside off, the batter hangs his bat out but gets beaten. The ball is collected by the keeper at head height.
Fayyaz Butt to bowl from the other end.
A bumper to end! The batsman evades it. End of a tidy first over.
In the air... short! Good change in pace there by Bilal. It is also slightly fuller. Aizaz is into the shot a touch early. He ends up chipping it just short of mid off. A run is also taken.
Nicely played and good running too! This is outside off, Aizaz opens the face of the bat and guides it wide of third man for two.
Good delivery and well played! This is a length ball which starts outside off and comes back in. Aizaz lunges and keeps it out.
Khan is underway! This is a little too straight from Bilal. Nizakat works it through square leg and takes one.
Some shape for the pacer! Bilal starts off with a low full toss, it tails back in from outside off. Khan strokes it towards mid on.

We are all set for the action to begin. The Oman fielders make their way out to the middle. Nizakat Khan and Aizaz Khan, the skipper come out to open the batting for Hong Kong. Bilal Khan is set to bowl the first over for Oman.

Aizaz Khan, the Hong Kong skipper, says they would have liked to bowl first. Mentions they need a good start now and need a good total. Admits they did not bowl well in the last game and hopefully they do well today. Informs they have the same XI.
Zeeshan Maqsood, the Oman skipper, says that they want to bowl first as there is a little bit of grass on the surface. Informs that they are going in with unchanged XI.
Hong Kong (Unchanged Playing XI): Aizaz Khan(c), Nizakat Khan, Kinchit Shah, Waqas Barkat, Simandeep Singh, Scott McKechnie(wk), Haroon Arshad, Shahid Wasif, Ehsan Khan, Kyle Christie, Nasrulla Rana.
Oman (Unchanged Playing XI): Khawar Ali, Jatinder Singh, Aqib Ilyas, Aamir Kaleem, Zeeshan Maqsood(c), Suraj Kumar(wk), Sandeep Goud, Mohammad Nadeem, Khurram Nawaz, Fayyaz Butt, Bilal Khan.
Toss - Oman win the toss and choose to bowl first.

Greetings and a warm welcome to Match 13 of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup Qualifier between Hong Kong and Oman. Oman come into this game on the back of a comfortable win over the hosts, UAE and they will be high on confidence. Their bowling was clinical and they were never in doubt of losing that game as they made the best use of the conditions. As for Hong Kong, they were brutally defeated by Ireland who thumped their bowlers all around the ground. The only bright spot for them was the performance of Kinchit Shah who showed some fight. Oman will be looking to gain another two points and make it two wins out of two whilst Hong Kong will be looking to earn their first points of the qualifiers. Stay tuned for all the action.
